title: Discord bot can't find discord.js from the plugins folder
body:
The Discord bot plugin loads `discord.js`, `@discordjs/voice` and `prism-media` with bare requires from `plugins/discord-bot/index.js`. Those packages live in `node-bot/node_modules`, and Node never looks there from `plugins/`, so starting the bot throws MODULE_NOT_FOUND. It has never been able to connect. The browser automation plugin had the same problem with `playwright-core`, which #1162 fixes.

I want the three requires pointed at node-bot's packages, the same way #1162 does it, plus a node-bot test that fails if any plugin gains a bare package require that doesn't resolve.

Out of scope: `plugins/document-reader` requires `pdf-parse`, which isn't in node-bot's dependencies at all, so PDF reading is broken too. Fixing that means adding a package, which I'll decide separately.
why: Plugin code outside node-bot/: the fix is three require paths in plugins/discord-bot/index.js. Tests whether she can find code from a symptom (MODULE_NOT_FOUND) and stay small.
